name: Founder decision: Ratify the separation protocol: three kinds of departure, the decision about staying designed in full, what may never cause or be cited in a departure, the conversation, final pay, dignity, and what managing out may never become
text_content:
P21, P22, P23, P26, P27, P28, P31, P38. A departure the person chooses is said to their check-in holder at any time, recorded as a last day from the person's words, asked no reason, with no consequence attached to short notice, and followed the same day by the departure state, field 15, the pool read, the leads' review line, coverage at the next brief, the exit interview offered, the pay page, and the employment record's items. The decision about staying is a reserved class with inputs only the hand-off package or the non-negotiable line with the flag's record and the person's words; present both partners and counsel and no one else; the order the failure-mode reference on the center's own mechanisms first with an unmade fix returning the item, the package whole with the person's words last, counsel's read on lawfulness only, then both or neither with the status quo as staying; concluding stays, stays with a move offered, or leaves on a date, and never a pay change, a probation, a label, a second window, or anything about the person's will or life; on the next partners' review's agenda, held at most one review with a reason written; recorded on the partners' page in a closed form in no one's voice about the person. Nothing may cause or be cited but those two records, and the refused causes are tabled with their rules. The decision is said by the partner who took it with the person's check-in holder present and an interpreter where needed, off the floor at a closed hour or a window with slack, on the clock on the next scheduled shift and never later than the second, before coverage and before the state is saved, in the person's language, in canon's correspondence register, with the state and its citation, the last day, what the person keeps, final pay as the pay page shows it, the exit interview offered, the hand-back, and the read-back, and with no reason beyond the citation, no comparison, no performed apology, and no negotiation; a stated record error or a legal word pauses it; one conversation for every seat. Final pay is the days worked and the accrued share to the last pay date, with no severance, exit package, negotiation, or withholding as a mechanism, and "separation payment, if any" a named, unset row recommended as one rule for every departure if set. The person keeps their pay page for their final pay, a copy of their own words on request, their competencies as facts, and their relationships as relationships with the record as the house's; the house never walks a person out in sight, removes access or shifts before the conversation, defaults to a same-day leave, says anything beyond coverage, contacts the person after for anything but pay, records, and the consented question, records a word on their behalf, or asks for a resignation in place of its decision. Managing out may never become a lead's decision, a case file, an argued conversation, a negotiation, a thinned schedule, a same-day escort, a departure on a refused record, a reduction with a person as its reason, a lingering decision, a word about a departed person, an unconsented read of a former team member, a departure dressed as the person's, a manager's observation of a life, an HR seat, or her vocabulary. Extends 17tn048qfn4, 17tn048qfnr, 86akh5u8m, 86akh5u77, 17tn048qeu8, and 17tn048qfp1 by reference. Before the first not-held close or the first line. Urgent.
